clips.send: Ice is crystalline. Its particles form a repeating pattern. At a fixed pressure, a pure crystal has a definite melting point. Ordinary glass is amorphous. Its particles lack a pattern that repeats over long distances, and it gradually softens over a range of temperatures.
clips.text: Ice is crystalline. Its particles form a repeating pattern. At a fixed pressure, a pure crystal has a definite melting point. Ordinary glass is amorphous. Its particles lack a pattern that repeats over long distances, and it gradually softens over a range of temperatures.

clips.send: At 1 atm, pure ice melts at about 0 degrees Celsius (32 degrees Fahrenheit ), and pure water boils at about 100 degrees Celsius (212 degrees Fahrenheit ). On each plateau, the sample still absorbs heat. The share of the mass in each phase changes while the temperature stays steady. At the same pressure, pure water freezes at about 0 degrees Celsius and releases heat as it freezes.
clips.text: At 1 atm, pure ice melts at about 0 °C (32 °F), and pure water boils at about 100 °C (212 °F). On each plateau, the sample still absorbs heat. The share of the mass in each phase changes while the temperature stays steady. At the same pressure, pure water freezes at about 0 °C and releases heat as it freezes.

clips.send: Evaporation happens at a liquid’s surface and can occur below its boiling point. During boiling, vaporization occurs at the surface and throughout the liquid, where vapor bubbles form. Both processes absorb heat.
clips.text: Evaporation happens at a liquid’s surface and can occur below its boiling point. During boiling, vaporization occurs at the surface and throughout the liquid, where vapor bubbles form. Both processes absorb heat.

clips.send: Ice in a drink absorbs heat and becomes liquid water.
clips.text: Ice in a drink absorbs heat and becomes liquid water.

clips.send: Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide. At ordinary air pressure it absorbs heat as it changes directly into gas.
clips.text: Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide. At ordinary air pressure it absorbs heat as it changes directly into gas.

clips.send: Hoarfrost forms when water vapor releases heat and becomes ice crystals directly on a cold surface.
clips.text: Hoarfrost forms when water vapor releases heat and becomes ice crystals directly on a cold surface.

clips.send: Estimate the temperature and choose a suitable range. Check the unit and the value of one small division. Each small interval here is 2 degrees Celsius . Fully immerse the bulb in the liquid. Keep the bulb clear of the container’s bottom and sides. Wait for the reading to stabilize. Keep the bulb immersed and read with your eyes level with the top of the liquid column.

clips.send: Water in an ice tray releases heat as it freezes. At a fixed pressure, ice and pure liquid water can coexist at one temperature. That temperature is both the melting point of ice and the freezing point of pure water.
clips.text: Water in an ice tray releases heat as it freezes. At a fixed pressure, ice and pure liquid water can coexist at one temperature. That temperature is both the melting point of ice and the freezing point of pure water.

clips.send: Water absorbs heat as a puddle evaporates or as water boils in a pot. Both processes turn liquid into gas.
clips.text: Water absorbs heat as a puddle evaporates or as water boils in a pot. Both processes turn liquid into gas.

clips.send: Water vapor in the air releases heat as it forms droplets on the outside of a cold glass. Cooling can cause condensation. At a suitable temperature, compressing a gas can also turn it into a liquid.
clips.text: Water vapor in the air releases heat as it forms droplets on the outside of a cold glass. Cooling can cause condensation. At a suitable temperature, compressing a gas can also turn it into a liquid.

clips.send: 冰是晶体，粒子按一定规律重复排列。压强一定时，纯晶体有固定的熔点。普通玻璃是非晶体，粒子的排列在较大范围内没有重复的规律。玻璃没有固定的熔点，受热时会在一段温度范围内逐渐软化。

clips.send: 水洼里的水蒸发或锅里的水沸腾时，水都吸热。这两种过程都是液态变为气态。
clips.text: 水洼里的水蒸发或锅里的水沸腾时，水都吸热。这两种过程都是液态变为气态。

clips.send: 饮料里的冰块吸热，从固态变成液态。
clips.text: 饮料里的冰块吸热，从固态变成液态。

clips.send: 冰格里的水凝固时向外放热。压强一定时，冰和纯液态水可以在同一温度下稳定共存，这一温度既是冰的熔点，也是纯水的凝固点。
clips.text: 冰格里的水凝固时向外放热。压强一定时，冰和纯液态水可以在同一温度下稳定共存，这一温度既是冰的熔点，也是纯水的凝固点。

clips.send: 蒸发在液体表面发生，低于沸点也能进行。沸腾时，汽化在液体表面和内部同时发生，液体内部形成蒸气泡。两种汽化方式都吸热。

clips.send: 干冰是固态二氧化碳。在通常的大气压下，干冰吸热，直接变成二氧化碳气体。
clips.text: 干冰是固态二氧化碳。在通常的大气压下，干冰吸热，直接变成二氧化碳气体。

clips.send: 空气中的水蒸气在寒冷表面直接变成冰晶，同时放热，形成白霜。
clips.text: 空气中的水蒸气在寒冷表面直接变成冰晶，同时放热，形成白霜。

clips.send: 空气中的水蒸气在冷玻璃杯外壁液化成水滴，同时放热。降低温度可以使气体液化。在适宜的温度下，压缩气体也可以使它液化。
clips.text: 空气中的水蒸气在冷玻璃杯外壁液化成水滴，同时放热。降低温度可以使气体液化。在适宜的温度下，压缩气体也可以使它液化。

clips.send: 先估计温度，再选量程合适的温度计。认清单位和分度值。图中相邻两条小刻度线对应的温度相差 2 摄氏度 。 把玻璃泡完全浸入待测液体，不要碰到容器底或容器壁。 等示数稳定后再读数。读数时玻璃泡要留在液体中，视线与液柱顶端相平。

clips.send: 在 1 个标准大气压下，纯冰在约 0 摄氏度 （32 度 F）熔化，纯水在约 100 摄氏度 （212 度 F）沸腾。平台段仍在吸热，各物态的质量占比在变化，温度保持不变。纯水在同一压强下约在 0 摄氏度 凝固，凝固时放热。
